import asyncio, tempfile, os
from agent_harness.domain.memory import MemoryScope, SessionTraceArchive, TraceItem
from agent_harness.storage.memory_sqlite import SQLiteMemoryStore

def arc(aid, scope, op, entry):
    return SessionTraceArchive(aid, scope, "s","l",op,"run",None,entry,(entry,),f"h-{entry}","conversation-v1",1,"c",(TraceItem(entry,1,1,"message","user",entry,{}),))

async def main():
    d = tempfile.mkdtemp()
    store = SQLiteMemoryStore(os.path.join(d,"m.db"), now_ms=lambda: 100)
    scope = MemoryScope("repo")
    a, created = await store.capture_archive(arc("a1", scope, "op", "e1"))
    b, created2 = await store.capture_archive(arc("a2", scope, "op", "e1"))
    print("created", created, created2, "same archive:", a.archive_id == b.archive_id, "store_seq", a.items[0].store_seq, b.items[0].store_seq)
    await store.create_or_wake_job(scope, "l1", 1, 0)
    j1 = await store.claim_job(100,"w1",10)
    print("claim1", j1.status, j1.attempt, j1.lease_id)
    print("claim while leased ->", await store.claim_job(105,"w2",10))
    j2 = await store.claim_job(110,"w2",10)
    print("takeover", j2.lease_id, j2.attempt)
    try:
        await store.complete_job(j1.job_id, "w1")
    except Exception as e:
        print("stale lease fenced:", type(e).__name__, e)
    await store.fail_job(j2.job_id, "w2", "TimeoutError", None)
    print("status after fail(None):", [x.status for x in await store.list_jobs(scope, None, None, 5)])
    print("audit events:", [r.event for r in await store.list_audit(scope, None, 20)])
    await store.replay_dead_letter(scope, j2.job_id)
    print("after replay:", [ (x.status, x.error_class) for x in await store.list_jobs(scope, None, None, 5)])
asyncio.run(main())
EOF
